## Load the packages

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(performance)
```

## Load the datasets

```{r}
cluster<-read.xlsx("../../../../00.info/metadata_passportdata_emmeans.xlsx")
chr1<-read.csv("../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/04.analysis_of_GWAS_outpout/analysis of GWAS outpout fabae /chr1L_1703281021/chr1L_final_window_genotype_groups.csv")
chr3<-read.csv("../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/04.analysis_of_GWAS_outpout/analysis of GWAS outpout fabae /chr3_641834492/haplo_chr3_641834492.csv")
chr5<-read.csv("../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/04.analysis_of_GWAS_outpout/analysis of GWAS outpout fabae /chr5_1299427225/haplo_chr5_1299427225.csv")
chr6<-read.csv("../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/04.analysis_of_GWAS_outpout/analysis of GWAS outpout fabae /chr6_369308865/haplo_chr6_369308865.csv")
emmean_fabae<-read.csv("../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/fabae/emmeans_fabae_4.csv")
emmean_fabae<-emmean_fabae[,c(1,2)]
emmean_fabae$ivip[emmean_fabae$ivip == "hedin"] <- "Hedin"
merge1<-merge(chr1,chr3, by="ivip",all = TRUE)
merge2<-merge(merge1,chr5, by="ivip",all = TRUE)
merge3<-merge(merge2,chr6, by="ivip",all = TRUE)
merge_haplotype_fabae<-merge(merge3,emmean_fabae, by="ivip",all = TRUE)
merge_haplotype_fabae[is.na(merge_haplotype_fabae)] <- "Unfavorable"
write.xlsx(merge_haplotype_fabae,"all_haplotype_fabae")
haplotype_cluster_fabae<-merge(merge_haplotype_fabae,cluster, by="ivip",all = TRUE)

raw_data_fabae<-read.csv("../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/01.dataset_filtering/01_A.fabae/final filters/aphis_fabae_data_filtered_4.csv")

raw_data_fabae$ivip[raw_data_fabae$ivip == "Hedin2"] <- "Hedin"

merge5<-merge(merge3,raw_data_fabae, by="ivip",all = TRUE)
merge5$Favorable_Count <- rowSums(merge5[, 2:5] == "Favorable", na.rm = TRUE)
merge5$Favorable_Count<-as.factor(merge5$Favorable_Count)
mod <- lmer(larvae_total_number ~ Favorable_Count + (1 |session/block), data = merge5)

emm <- emmeans(mod, "Favorable_Count")

# Count the number of Favorable alleles in columns 2-5
haplotype_cluster_fabae$Favorable_Count <- rowSums(haplotype_cluster_fabae[, 2:5] == "Favorable", na.rm = TRUE)

# Rename column 6 (optional)
names(haplotype_cluster_fabae)[6] <- "emmeans"

mod_cumulated_effect<-lm(emmean ~ haplo_chr1L_1703281021 + haplo_chr3_641834492 + haplo_chr5_1299427225 + haplo_chr6_369308865, data = merge_haplotype_fabae)

R2    <- summary(mod_cumulated_effect)$r.squared
R2adj <- summary(mod_cumulated_effect)$adj.r.squared
cat("Variance explained by the 4 QTL: R2 =", round(R2, 3),
    "| adjusted R2 =", round(R2adj, 3), "\n")


```

```{r}


p <- ggplot(haplotype_cluster_fabae, aes(x = factor(Favorable_Count), y = emmeans)) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 2,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of favorable alleles",
    y = "Estimated marginal mean"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "Helvetica")

ggsave(
  "Figure_cumulated_effect_fabae.eps",
  plot = p,
  device = "eps",
  width = 3.5,
  height = 3.0,
  units = "in"
)


letters_fabae <- cld(emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters)
letters_fabae

```

```{r}

# the 4 haplotype columns
haplo_cols <- c("haplo_chr1L_1703281021",
                "haplo_chr3_641834492",
                "haplo_chr5_1299427225",
                "haplo_chr6_369308865")

# output folder
dir.create("boxplots_svg", showWarnings = FALSE)

for (col in haplo_cols) {

  # drop missing haplotype calls for this locus
  df <- merge_haplotype_fabae %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[col]]))

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(.data[[col]]), y = emmean)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "grey85", colour = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 45)) +
    labs(title = col, x = "Haplotype", y = "emmean") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14)

  ggsave(filename = file.path("boxplots_svg", paste0("boxplot_", col, ".svg")),
         plot = p, device = "svg", width = 6, height = 5)
}


```

chr1<-read.csv("../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/04.analysis_of_GWAS_outpout/analysis of GWAS outpout pisum/chr1S_1240520268/haplo_chr1S_1240520268.csv")

mod_cumulated_effect<-lm(emmean ~ haplo_chr1S_1240520268 + chr2_1461736473 + haplo_chr2_35683372 + haplo_chr2_920208494, data = merge_haplotype_pisum)

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)   # install.packages("patchwork")

fabae_cols <- c("haplo_chr1L_1703281021", "haplo_chr3_641834492",
                "haplo_chr5_1299427225", "haplo_chr6_369308865")
pisum_cols <- c("haplo_chr1S_1240520268", "chr2_1461736473",
                "haplo_chr2_35683372", "haplo_chr2_920208494")

make_row <- function(data, haplo_cols, row_title) {

  df_long <- data %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(haplo_cols), names_to = "locus", values_to = "haplotype") %>%
    filter(!is.na(haplotype)) %>%
    mutate(locus = factor(locus, levels = haplo_cols))

  ggplot(df_long, aes(x = haplotype, y = emmean)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "grey85", colour = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 45), breaks = seq(0, 45, by = 5)) +
    facet_wrap(~ locus, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
    labs(title = row_title, x = "Haplotype", y = "emmean") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      axis.text         = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black"),
      axis.title        = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.ticks        = element_line(linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
      axis.line         = element_line(linewidth = 0.8),
      strip.text        = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      strip.background  = element_blank(),
      plot.title        = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold.italic"),
      panel.spacing     = unit(1, "lines")
    )
}

p_pisum <- make_row(merge_haplotype_pisum, pisum_cols, "A. pisum")
p_fabae <- make_row(merge_haplotype_fabae, fabae_cols, "A. fabae")

# pisum on top, fabae below
p_all <- p_pisum / p_fabae

ggsave("boxplots_grid_2x4.svg", p_all, device = "svg", width = 20, height = 12)
```
